instrumentation.note: Full candidate gate on the release-critical classes. DocumentNavigationTest's two long-press popup cases are excluded because they reproduce identically on the 1.2.0 baseline APK in this emulator state; both raw failures are retained in the session log and are not attributed to 1.2.1. New suites included: AbbreviationLookupTest 7, SenseDomainRankingTest 7, InkFountainPenTest 11, InkPerformanceTest 4, InkAcceptanceComparisonTest 1, DictionarySearchUpgradeTest 13, ContactIntentTest 4, ArmGuardTest 1, WritingExperienceAcceptanceTest 3, InkLedgerTest 6, StrokeContinuityTest 7, InkPredictorTest 8, InkDynamicsTest 12.

updateChannel: unchanged; latest public release remains v1.2.0 (https://github.com/dpan538/Annota/releases/tag/v1.2.0)
knownLimitations: P1 first-frame cost increases ~25-90% because the page Picture is recorded (software canvas); steady-state frames improve 2-2.9x. Hardware-layer benefit still needs device measurement.
P3 fountain v5 has no multi-point tail replay at ACTION_UP; release taper depends on the final pressure drop. Single-dot cap is ~72% of v4 by design.
Abbreviation/initialism candidates only surface with context evidence; unknown acronyms with no context fall back to ordinary word lookup.
Domain labels are coarse lexfiles: cell battery/spreadsheet/prison cannot be separated by domain alone.
Reverse zh-en entries are machine-merged; not individually proofread.
Emulator results do not replace Xiaomi Pad 9 Pro Max handwriting, frame-rate, thermal or memory acceptance.

The writing-experience evidence (IEA/ITL/SCR/NPDE/PRC) is synthetic stylus input on an API 36 ARM64 emulator; real-device forearm contacts, 240 Hz pen timing, haptics and long-session handwriting still need acceptance on the Xiaomi Pad 9 Pro Max.

ITL commits asynchronously: a process killed between ledger append and snapshot is recovered from the ledger, but a duplicate of the last snapshot-covered stroke is possible only in the tiny crash window between snapshot write and ledger trim.
SCR refuses gaps >64 ms, across pen lifts, and large turns; it never extrapolates past the last real sample.
PRC predictions are display-only and are never persisted or exported; low-confidence predictions are faded, and a fast flick is limited to one low-confidence frame.

IEA excludes edge gestures only while the pen/forearm is active; a deliberate edge swipe after the guard window still leaves. A synthetic forearm scenario stops accidental exits, but the threshold needs real-device calibration.

iea.syntheticForearmThenBack: baseline exits to LibraryScreen; candidate keeps FrameLayout/reader
